newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner wins two deals worth NOK 400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner wins two deals worth NOK 400 mln.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Kvaerner ASA said on Friday its German paper and pulp subsidiary Bison had won contracts worth 400 million crowns in Thailand and Canada.
Kvaerner said in a statement Bison's headquarters in Springe would supply a straw particle-board production plant to the Canadian company Isobord in Toronto.
"This order is worth almost $40 million," the statement said. "It includes the delivery of all machines and equipment for material preparation, pressing and boarding handling."
The second contract has been signed with a joint venture called Siam Riso Wood Products Co. Ltd.
Ruang Uthai Industry Co. is the main shareholder, and specialises in the processing of rubberwood trees. The total investment on the new plant will be $25 million, it said.
"Kvaerner Bison will be responsible for the total delivery, including control systems and environmental protection equipment for a particle-board plant," the statement said.
